effects: Exactly `assets` USDT moves from the signer to the vault (safeTransferFrom in enter), using an earlier USDT approval.
New vault shares are minted to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets) at the current share price, and the call has no minimum.
Interest and fee accrual runs first and sets the share price. The deposited USDT may go on to the liquidity adapter. Neither touches the signer's balances directly.
formats.shown: Deposit 10 USDT for the onBehalf address. Fields show the USDT amount, a constant share ticker 'sbUSDT' and who gets the shares. The number of shares is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: constant share ticker 'sbUSDT' does not match the vault's on-chain symbol 'sbUSDTx'.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "sbUSDT", shown as field 'Share ticker' = sbUSDT; case 0 mined effect: minted share token 0x65a6…909b has symbol "sbUSDTx".
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to the on-chain symbol "sbUSDTx", or drop the constant field and name the share token another way.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is set by the vault price and is never shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` has no minShares parameter. Case 0: 10 sbUSDTx minted to the signer, and the screen shows no amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The amount is not in calldata.

findings.title: deposit: the label 'Deposit asset' sits on an amount, and 'Share ticker' is a static raw line.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit fields: label "Deposit asset" on path assets (tokenAmount); label "Share ticker" format raw value $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker.
findings.fix: Use the label 'Amount to deposit'. Put the ticker in a label such as 'Send sbUSDTx shares to'.

cases.notes: The 10 USDT out is shown right. The shares in show the right recipient and roughly the right ticker (sbUSDT vs on-chain sbUSDTx), but no amount, so the reader did not know how many.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Vault shares are burned from `onBehalf`. The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, and the call has no maximum.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, the burn spends the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf`.
Exactly `assets` USDT goes from the vault to `receiver`.
If idle USDT is short, the vault pulls liquidity back from the liquidity adapter. This is not the signer's balance.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly N USDT to the receiver. Fields show the amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares are used. The shares burned are not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is set by the vault price and is not shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`, with no maxShares parameter. Case 0x136c… (case 1): 0.995592703044362984 sbUSDTx burned from the signer, and no field shows it.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. Labelling the owner 'Shares taken from' would hint at the burn.

cases.notes: The 1.000196 USDT in is shown right. The reader guessed their position falls by about the same value but did not know shares are burned or how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `shares` vault shares are burned from `onBehalf`.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, the burn spends the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf`.
USDT worth previewRedeem(shares) goes from the vault to `receiver`. The call has no minimum.
If idle USDT is short, the vault pulls liquidity back from the liquidity adapter (Morpho).
formats.shown: Redeem 10 sbUSDT to the receiver. Fields show the shares, the receiver and the owner. Nothing says USDT is paid out or how much.

findings.title: redeem: neither the intent nor any field says USDT is what the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem interpolatedIntent "Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}". VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. Case 2: the reader was 'unsure which token is paid out (USDT assumed)'.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Redeem for USDT' and the interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDT to {#.receiver}', or label the receiver 'Send USDT to'.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT received is set by the vault price, has no minimum, and is not shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` has no minAssets parameter. Case 2: 10.064433 USDT reached the signer, and no amount was shown.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The amount is not in calldata.

findings.title: redeem: the shares render as 'sbUSDT' while the vault's on-chain symbol is 'sbUSDTx'.
findings.evidence: Case 2 screen 'Shares to redeem' = "10 sbUSDT" (tokenPath @.to). Mined effect: the burned token 0x65a6…909b has symbol "sbUSDTx".
findings.fix: Make sure the wallet's token list matches the on-chain symbol. The descriptor's tokenPath itself is correct.

cases.notes: The 10-share burn is shown right. The USDT in shows the recipient but not the asset or the amount. The reader guessed USDT.
